title: Armenia's cyber police say Telegram fraud attempts posing as the National Security Service are more frequent
date_note: News.am gives only its publication day, 25 November; the police statement's own day is not stated.
geo_basis: Armenian police cyber unit, country as stated by the source
summary: According to Armenia's Cyber Police, attempts at fraud on Telegram in the name of the National Security Service (SNB) have become more frequent. Residents are called or messaged by people posing as SNB employees who, under various pretexts, ask them to withdraw money from bank accounts, convert it to crypto assets and send it to accounts or wallets the scammers provide. The article gives no figures.
plain: Armenian cyber police say scammers on Telegram pretend to be state security officers and push people to move their money into crypto wallets the scammers control.
exec: Armenian cyber police warn of a rise in Telegram scams impersonating the state security service.
action: Armenia's Cyber Police advise ignoring such calls and messages, not sending money or crypto assets, and reporting suspicious cases to law enforcement.
